messages:
Maya: Quick, totally non-work poll — what's one song you can still sing word-for-word? no judgement :grin:
Devon: 'Africa' by Toto. I can hit the opening line and then pretend I knew the lyrics all along :sweat_smile:
Sam: Don't Stop Believin' — every. single. line. guilty pleasure :muscle:
Iris: The Sailor Moon theme (english dub) — only the chorus but with theatrical gestures 
Carlos: Wannabe by Spice Girls. I will perform it unironically and with choreography :raised_hands: 
Maya: Haha these are iconic. Bonus: would you come to a low-key team karaoke night? :microphone:
Devon: Count me in. I'll bring a disastrous air-guitar solo.
Sam: I'm in. Also prepared to provide kazoo accompaniment if requested.
Iris: Only if there are snacks. Priorities. :cookie:
Carlos: Snacks + bad lighting = perfect. Also I can do a mean backup clap rhythm.
KudosBot: Maya's message got a :tada: reaction from 3 people.
Maya: OK team karaoke plan: who's free a friday night? drop a :thumbsup: if yes, :wave: if maybe, :no_entry_sign: if absolutely not.
Devon: :thumbsup:
Sam: :thumbsup:
Iris: :wave: (could be late for family stuff)
Carlos: :thumbsup: — bringing Spice Girls energy
Maya: Love this. I'll make a tiny doodle poll later and maybe a playlist. Feel free to DM song requests.
Sam: I demand 'Bohemian Rhapsody' for full dramatic lighting.
Devon: Agreed. Also surprise kazoo solo.
Iris: I'll coordinate snacks (allergies?) — put any dietary notes in the poll.
Carlos: Peanuts = no go for me.
Maya: noted. Alright, end of micro watercooler meeting. Thanks for playing along :sparkles:
